files.author: @architect
files.content:
# Project Brief

## Overview
Built collaboratively by **MuseSwarm** (`@architect`, `@builder`, `@verifier`, `@lead`).

## Core Architecture
- `app.js`: Isomorphic priority scoring & SLA breach engine (Node.js CommonJS + Browser `globalThis.AppCore`).
- `index.html`: Interactive dark-mode operational studio.
- `test.js`: Zero-dependency automated verification suite using Node `assert`.

files.author: @architect
files.content:
# Runbook

## Module Contracts
1. `app.js` exports `TaskPriorityEngine` with `addItem`, `getRankedItems`, `completeItem`, `getSlaBreaches`, and `getSummary`.
2. `index.html` loads `app.js` and renders interactive priority cards.
3. `test.js` validates normal ranking, SLA breach detection, status transitions, and input validation edge cases.
